request.spec: Exports taken while a preview date is set use the preview figures.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Exports taken while a preview date is set use the preview figures.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The app already did what this change asks for, so the only edit I made is to comments. `bin/e2e` passed all 4 tests in the spec before I touched anything. That includes the main check: with today set to 2026-03-01, Ada's due exports as 10.00; with a preview date of 2026-05-01 it exports as 11.00 in both the people and claims CSVs; after clearing the preview it goes back to 10.00.

**Why it already worked:** the exports work out their figures the same way the screen does, and the screen already uses the preview date:
- Every due figure takes its "today" from `useSheetToday` (`features/session/session.ts`), which returns the preview date while one is set.
- `api/http.ts` adds `?preview=<date>` to every read of a sheet.
- Setting or clearing a preview reloads all the data, and each export waits until that reload finishes before building its file.

**What I changed:** only the comments in `features/export/export.slot.tsx`. They described how the people, claims and pools exports behave under an as-of date but not a preview date, so I added that. I didn't re-run `bin/e2e` after this, since only comments changed.
